name: v1.1.0
body:
## Changelog
* : Add NewBuild for rootCmd.Version (@mrusme)
* : Add SID validation handling (@mrusme)
* : Add block fix command (@mrusme)
* : Add default case for argparser (@mrusme)
* : Add error handling (@mrusme)
* : Add importer format error handling (@mrusme)
* : Add week padding (@mrusme)
* : Clean up argsparser, add errs (@mrusme)
* : Fix "last quarter", change from UTC to local, fix periodRegex, argparser (@mrusme)
* : Fix --color shadowing, rename to --display-color (@mrusme)
* : Fix DestroyRow (@mrusme)
* : Fix SID DisplayName, fix FitDisplayName for UTF (@mrusme)
* : Fix command names for argsparser.PDP (@mrusme)
* : Fix config loading (@mrusme)
* : Fix db.engine.Close() (@mrusme)
* : Fix endless loop bug (@mrusme)
* : Fix error output, direct to stderr (@mrusme)
* : Fix export output, fix JSON, adjust durations (ms -> s), is_running (@mrusme)
* : Fix import end (@mrusme)
* : Fix overlapping block inclusion, add proper clipping (@mrusme)
* : Fix spelling mistake (@mrusme)
* : Fix task command, add project SID handling (@mrusme)
* : Fix timestamp period match (@mrusme)
* : Fix unbounded timeframes, `zeit block <key>`, `zeit end` on running p/t (@mrusme)
* : Fix version output (@mrusme)
* : Optimize project/task queries (@mrusme)
* : Optimize validator init (@mrusme)
* : Refactor stats aggregation, timestamp helper (@mrusme)
* : Refactor/fix v1 importer (@mrusme)
* : Remove key json tag (@mrusme)
* : Remove runtime from version command (@mrusme)
* : Remove unused errstr (@mrusme)
* : Replace Index with HasPrefix for keys (@mrusme)
* : Update README.md (@mrusme)
* : Update dependencies (@mrusme)
* : Update shield (@mrusme)
